messages:
omar: Heads-up — restore job for prod-snap-2026-03-22 failing with AccessDenied from KMS when trying to decrypt the snapshot chunks. Started ~08:12 UTC. Anyone touch uploader roles last 24h?

maya: saw the alert. which service identity is the restore using?

omar: restore service uses serviceAccount: backup-restore@redwood-prod. uploader/uploader-agent uploads use backup-uploader@redwood-prod. Both were part of the RBAC cleanup yesterday (policy prune).

li: hmm, we removed a set of legacy iam:roles around kms decrypt yesterday per the cleanup PR. I flagged a couple of service accounts but maybe missed the restore SA.

devops-bot: Deploybot: iam-prune-job completed 2026-03-22T03:17Z — removed roles: kms.decrypt:legacy-binding-3.

maya: can we confirm the KMS grants on the CMK? quick check: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/backup/cryptoKeys/prod-snap-key` or `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/prod-snap-key` depending on provider.

omar: running a quick audit now, pulling audit logs for kms:Decrypt and iam.policy changes.

li: FYI the iam prune PR comment mentioned not touching `backup-restore` but maybe the service account name mismatch caused it.

maya: mitigation idea: add a temporary grant scoped to `backup-restore@redwood-prod` with Decrypt and Encrypt, TTL 1h, then retry restore. If that works, we can roll a minimal long-term fix.

security-bot: Incident-bot: create INC-2026-033 — Snapshot restore failure due to KMS AccessDenied — assigned to eng-security oncall.

omar: creating temp grant now (will post commands). If provider=GCP: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ... --member=serviceAccount:backup-restore@redwood-prod --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` If AWS: `aws kms create-grant --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/backup-restore --operations Decrypt Encrypt --name temp-restore-grant`

li: I'm applying the grant on prod CMK. please hold restore until it's applied.

(devops-bot edits): applied grant on prod CMK, grant-id: g-07a1b2c3.

tasha: retrying restore now. status: in-progress.

omar: restore progressed past decrypt stage, now decompressing shards. looks good so far.

maya: after we finish, we should audit exactly which IAM change removed the long-lived grant and add a tag to the prune job to skip backup-* service accounts.

li: +1. I'll open a follow-up PR to update the iam-prune whitelist and add an integration test for snapshot restore svc identities.

omar: action items: 1) temp grant applied and restore succeeded (monitoring). 2) li to update prune whitelist + test. 3) security to review audit trail and close INC-2026-033 once postmortem done.

omaR (edited): small note — we should also verify archive replicas in object-store still have correct `x-encrypt-meta` headers; some older uploader clients skip metadata during multipart uploads. if found, we need a rewrap job.

maya: adding a short checklist to the incident ticket: `- verify re-encrypt metadata on S3/GCS objects` `- run kms:ListGrants vs expected` `- update iam-prune policy` `- add canary restore job to CI`

tasha: thanks everyone. pinging oncall for a quick blameless postmortem tomorrow. :thumbsup:

security-bot: Incident-bot: INC-2026-033 updated — status: mitigated, timeline appended, owners assigned.
